ranked.title: India confidence_pct is anti-correlated with forward return
ranked.hypothesis: In India, higher confidence_pct at prediction time predicts LOWER 5D forward win rate. Bucket audit shows WR spread of 23.88pp with monotonicity MIXED_DOWN.
ranked.expected_effect: If we INVERT confidence's contribution to R1 ranking OR treat conf_70_85 as a WARN not GO signal in India, expected 5D WR lift of ~10pp on affected cohort (n>=180).
ranked.proposed_rule: Config-toggle in a shadow R1 ranker: multiply confidence contribution by -1 (or set to 0) in India-only. Requires new shadow R1 output stream · does NOT modify production R1.
ranked.risk: Confidence is calibrated on a different objective (thesis-strength). Inversion may destroy long-run signal even while helping short-term. MUST run in shadow only · never in production R1.

ranked.title: India top-3 rank slot underperforms rank_4_7 (ranker inversion)
ranked.hypothesis: India R1 places QUALITY(57%) + OK(40%) high-confidence stocks in top-3 slots · these have 14.5% 5D WR. Meanwhile R2 rank_4_7 (n=56, 47% WR, +0.53% avg) is the only positive cohort. The ranker's top-3 selection is anti-correlated with outcome.
ranked.expected_effect: Rank-slot filter test: 'reject R1 top-3 in India unless additional MA20-dist +1..+5 filter passes' should lift avg return by ~+0.5% on the affected 82-prediction cohort.
ranked.proposed_rule: In a shadow India ranker: gate any rank-1-to-3 output through a 'ma20_dist_pct BETWEEN +1 AND +5' filter. Non-passing candidates demoted to rank_4_7. Config-flag OFF by default.
ranked.risk: Filter may over-tighten and reduce total NEW recommendations. Track daily rec-count delta. If drop >30% for 5 consecutive days, roll back.

ranked.title: India AEGIS produces -6.48pp NEGATIVE alpha vs universe
ranked.hypothesis: Over 18 days, NSE universe (n=2747) 5D WR=32.25% avg=-0.388%. AEGIS-India (n=392) 5D WR=25.77% avg=-0.729%. Alpha = WR-6.48pp · avg-0.341%. AEGIS-India currently DESTROYS value relative to random pick.
ranked.expected_effect: This is the master finding · the fix is the combined effect of tickets T1 (confidence), T2 (rank), T3 (band), T4 (stop). Individual candidates each address ~1-2pp of the -6.48pp gap. Only in combination can alpha be restored above zero.
ranked.proposed_rule: Compound proposal: enable ALL of T1+T2+T3+T4 in a single shadow India runner instance. Compare compound-shadow vs production on identical days for 30 forward sessions.
ranked.risk: Compound experiments are hard to attribute. Run components in isolation FIRST for 10 days each · then combined for 20 days.

ranked.title: India OK band underperforms AVOID · boundary miscalibrated
ranked.hypothesis: India investability_band ordering QUALITY > MARGINAL > AVOID > OK instead of expected QUALITY > OK > MARGINAL > AVOID. OK band (n=119) has 17.4% 5D WR · below AVOID (n=108) 19.2% · suggesting OK's internal calibration is broken.
ranked.expected_effect: Re-tuning OK/MARGINAL thresholds using forward-return-optimized cutoffs should lift OK cohort WR from 17.4% to 24-28% (mid MARGINAL range).
ranked.proposed_rule: In a shadow Investability engine: re-derive OK/MARGINAL split by sorting all historical predictions by underlying investability score and picking the split point that maximizes forward WR spread. Emit under new investability_shadow_v2_india.json alongside existing shadow.
ranked.risk: Sorting purely by forward return risks overfitting to the 30-day backtest window. Regularize the split point against a walk-forward cross-validation.

ranked.title: India TIME_STOP_5D beats CURRENT by 0.273% expectancy
ranked.hypothesis: Under 30-day historical replay, TIME_STOP_5D exit produces avg expectancy of -0.613% vs CURRENT -0.886%. TIME_STOP_5D also eliminates all catastrophic >10% losses (0.00% vs 0.20%).
ranked.expected_effect: Gap = 0.273%. Applied to production: ~0.27% expectancy improvement per position, zero catastrophic losses in this sample.
ranked.proposed_rule: In a shadow exit engine: for every ACTIVE position beyond 5 trading days from entry, emit ADVISORY 'time-exit candidate'. Do NOT modify the production stop or exit. Config-flag OFF.
ranked.risk: 5-day time exit forfeits the tail of longer-holding winners. Track MFE-captured metric alongside expectancy.

rationale: Score = severity*3 + verdict*2 + evidence*1 + preventability*2. Preventability bumps mechanisms that reduce future losses. n>=500 gets max evidence points. Never breaks a tie by title or market · ties keep original order.
